messages:
maria: Heads up — our sampleapp auth flow is failing for a couple of customers. They hit 403s in prod but curl -> REST endpoint works. Suspect SDK is omitting the scope header by default.

devon: ugh. are we talking about the x-client-scope header we added for tenant scoping? or the query param 'scope'?

maria: x-client-scope. The REST example we ship does:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "x-client-scope: orders.read" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer
```
But the node sampleapp using the SDK does: `client.generate({})` and no scope header ends up on the wire.

shaun: can you paste the exact SDK call from sampleapp? Might be a config mismatch where sampleapp sets client.defaults.scope vs call-level param.

maria: here's the sample snippet from sampleapp: 
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood();
await client.generate({ prompt: 'hi' });
```
No scope anywhere. REST docs show scope in header, sampleapp expects default from env but not set.

devon: ok so two separate problems: docs show header-based scoping, sampleapp relies on defaultScope env var, and SDK default behavior is to omit header if undefined. That part's fine. The mismatch is more about onboarding docs vs examples.

kevin: there's also a subtle retry thing — SDK will retry 401->refresh token automatically and replay request but it doesn't re-add transient headers from some middleware. If defaultScope was injected by a middleware that runs after auth, it might be lost on replay. Seen that before.

maria: interesting — i can reproduce locally by setting DEFAULT_SCOPE in env and then doing a token refresh flow. If I force a token expiry, the retried request arrives to server without x-client-scope. logs: 
```
[sdk] -> POST /v1/infer (Authorization: Bearer REDACTED)
[sdk] headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }
[auth] refresh token -> success
[sdk] -> RETRY POST /v1/infer (Authorization: Bearer REDACTED)
[sdk] headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }
```
note missing x-client-scope on retry.

shaun: that's a bug then — retries should carry all request headers including injected ones. Could be our idempotency/replay layer creating a fresh request object.

sdk-bot: CI alert: failing test 'auth/retry preserves custom headers' on main (introduced in 2.4.1). @devon assigned.

devon: thx bot. I'll add a unit to ensure header propagation on replay and check the middleware ordering. Quick workaround: set the scope explicitly on each call: `client.generate({ scope: 'orders.read', prompt: 'hi' })`.

maria: raising docs + sampleapp PR to clarify defaultScope env and add explicit scope param in example. Also adding note about retry header propagation until patch lands.

kevin: can we patch SDK to copy all original headers into retry request in 2.4.2? Should be small — copy header map before auth middleware mutates it. I'll open a PR and link here.

shaun: also add an e2e that simulates token refresh path and asserts header presence. That should prevent regressions.

maria: thanks. action items: 1) devon to patch replay layer (PR URL TBD) 2) kevin to add e2e test 3) i will update sampleapp and docs (PR #1234) 4) temporary user-facing note in status page.

devon: starting PR now, ping me if you want to pair on the test harness.

maria: appreciated. :thumbsup:
